bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · resting on the Oct 19 low
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 停在 10月19日低点

read.en: Meta fell 1.6% on Oct 20 to $694.25, its fifth straight lower close. It is below the rising 30-day average ($714.0) and the 5-day ($716.7) and 10-day ($725.0), but above the 200-day ($632.4) and 100-day ($629.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and is above zero with the histogram widening, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($766.86), and RSI is 46.
read.zh: Meta 10月20日下跌 1.6%，收于 $694.25，为连续第五个交易日收低。股价位于上行的 30 日均线（$714.0）及下行的 5 日（$716.7）和 10 日均线（$725.0）下方，但仍远高于 200 日（$632.4）和 100 日均线（$629.2）。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，柱状图扩大，抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$766.86），RSI 为 46。

read.en: The $702.7 Oct 16 low broke on the close; the day's low reached $681.05, just above the $679.6 top of the Sep 21 gap. Resistance is $702.7, then $714–717 (30 and 5-day averages) and $725 (10-day). Support is $694, then $680 (gap top) and $632 (200-day). A close below $680 would open the 200-day; a close above $717 would target $725.
read.zh: $702.7 的 10月16日低点在收盘时失守；盘中低点 $681.05，略高于 9月21日缺口上沿 $679.6。阻力为 $702.7，其次 $714–717（30 日和 5 日均线）和 $725（10 日均线）。支撑为 $694，其次 $680（缺口上沿）和 $632（200 日均线）。若收盘跌破 $680，下一目标看 200 日均线；若收盘站上 $717，下一目标看 $725。

s.en: Oct 20 low $681.1; top of the Sep 21 gap ($679.6)
